source_row.evidence_detail: The DUPB sense profiles cumplicidade/conivência as a state of the complicit participant. PropBank complicit.01 assigns ARG1 to the thing that is complicit and ARG2 only to the companion/action with which it is complicit. The holder selected by this sense therefore maps to ARG1; this is sense-specific and does not propagate to other cumplicidade senses.

source_row.evidence_detail: DUPB sense is explicitly miscelânea, i.e. a mixture/assortment. PropBank mix.01 defines ARG1 as ingredient one and allows multiple/merged ingredients to be realized together as ARG1; the nominal mixing example likewise groups the mixed items in ARG1. The frozen V1 content/domain relation therefore maps to the set of contents composing the miscellany, ARG1, without positional inference.
